smell_validity.evidence: The (line, match_info, index) row is genuinely born, carried and consumed together, yet five signatures across finder, model, view and dispatch dissolve it into three loose parameters, renaming the fields in the view; trivial helpers returning one ignored field expose the fault without any label, and a second real clump (matcher flags restated per site) reinforces it.

maintenance_impact.evidence: The row falls apart at every layer boundary, so a row-shape change or a new flag forces re-reading the whole pipeline; the renamed view variant hides the shared bundle, two clone paths can drift, and flag re-derivations must agree at five sites. Repair restores clear row and configuration ownership, though not an architecture-level boundary.

development_plausibility.evidence: Idiomatic drift: each helper arises where a caller just unpacked a tuple, per-module field names show team drift, and naming and style match the surroundings. Minor tells remain: duplicated trivial one-field helpers and build_clone bypassing the base clone_as read slightly task-shaped.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: An unusually decisive contract: finished state (row passed as one value including the renamed view variant; one flag configuration path, single touch per new flag), preserved plain writable flag attributes for rc files, external selection consumers unchanged, concrete behavior list, and exclusions against rendering, option renames and lookalike signatures, without prescribing implementation.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Distinct purposes demand distinct decisions: row generation re-inlines invert filtering under the empty-query guard; selection rows are reshaped with a different middle field for two call shapes; rendering picks style from display state; dispatch extracts text; flags involve separate startup derivation, single-flag toggle mutation and clone delegation.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names files and roles, not signatures: the solver must trace the row across finder, model, view and dispatch, resolve the view field-name aliases, exclude lookalikes such as split_query commands and cli attribute copying, and locate clone call sites for flag carrying. A second combined indirect mechanism beyond the aliasing is not established.

repair_coordination.evidence: Two rule pairs interlock: rows must cross boundaries as one value while selection rows keep a different, externally consumed middle field, so one home must serve both shapes; and one flag-configuration path must coexist with required plain attribute writes, coupling startup, toggle and clone rules. A forced cross-stage partial failure is not established.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform rule, passing the existing result-row tuple as a single value, repairs roughly eight of eleven clumped signatures across finder, model, view and dispatch without behavioral decisions; the three matcher-flag signatures resist it because each site re-derives flags differently. Coverage sits in the 60 to 80 percent band.

behavioral_risk.evidence: All three flags are positional booleans, so a transposed re-derivation compiles and silently misapplies them; dropping the empty-query invert guard passes ordinary filtering and fails only with -v plus an empty query; selection-row field corruption and toggle-then-switch staleness are similar hidden paths. No test or execution records establish them unchecked, so level-4 conditions are unmet.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
